ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (38) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Демофил» (Demofil) is given as Demophilus, and «Беседы Сократа» (Besedy Sokrata, 'Conversations of Socrates') stays without title quotes as printed; the Talmud attribution has no final period in the print and none is added. In Demophilus's «в вещах непорочных и гибнущих» the evident reading «непрочных» (neprochnykh, 'unstable') is translated instead of the printed «непорочных» (neporochnykh, 'blameless'); see flags.

Source observation: [31] «в вещах непорочных и гибнущих» ('in things blameless and perishing'): «непорочных» (neporochnykh, 'blameless') looks like a one-letter slip for «непрочных» (neprochnykh, 'unstable, flimsy'), which alone fits «гибнущих» ('perishing') and the sense of the saying; translated as 'unstable'.
